original_units_utf8:
{
  "version": 1,
  "units": [
    {
      "id": "ipv4-foundations",
      "track": "CCNA",
      "title": "IPv4 addressing and diagnosis",
      "summary": "Find subnet boundaries, allocate networks, and diagnose a workstation configuration. These labs cover part of CCNA addressing, not the whole exam.",
      "prerequisites": [],
      "labs": [
        "ccna-ipv4",
        "ccna-vlsm",
        "ccna-gateway"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "vlan-data-foundations",
      "track": "CCNA",
      "title": "VLAN groups, trunks and handover",
      "summary": "Connect workgroups, carry tagged traffic, understand native classification and diagnose a three-group handover. Native port tables and broadcast evidence; restricted data plane, without STP or Cisco CLI.",
      "prerequisites": [],
      "labs": [
        "ccna-vlan-access",
        "ccna-vlan-trunk",
        "ccna-vlan-native",
        "ccna-vlan-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ethernet-learning",
      "track": "CCNA",
      "title": "Ethernet learning, aging and recovery",
      "summary": "Build source-to-port knowledge, repair an older table selectively, prove quiet-period behavior and hand over two groups across three switches. Original finite Ethernet simulation; no IOS terminal, STP or real equipment equivalence.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "vlan-data-foundations"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "ccna-mac-learn-paths",
        "ccna-mac-stale-location",
        "ccna-mac-source-refresh",
        "ccna-mac-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ipv4-static-foundations",
      "track": "CCNA",
      "title": "IPv4 routes, return paths and resilient handover",
      "summary": "Build network routes, diagnose replies and overlapping entries, create a host exception and prove a primary/backup branch handover. Bounded native static forwarding; no IOS interpreter or dynamic protocols.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "ipv4-foundations"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "ccna-ipv4-network-route",
        "ccna-ipv4-return-route",
        "ccna-ipv4-specific-route",
        "ccna-ipv4-host-exception",
        "ccna-ipv4-floating-route",
        "ccna-ipv4-branch-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ipv6-static-foundations",
      "track": "CCNA",
      "title": "IPv6 links, routes and recovery",
      "summary": "Configure an IPv6 workstation, diagnose local versus remote paths, scope link-local next hops, repair route preference and verify a branch handover. Bounded static simulation, not full router protocol coverage.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "ipv4-foundations"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "ccna-ipv6-neighbor",
        "ccna-ipv6-workstation",
        "ccna-ipv6-scope",
        "ccna-ipv6-specific-route",
        "ccna-ipv6-backup",
        "ccna-ipv6-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "linux-file-foundations",
      "track": "LPIC-1",
      "title": "Files, paths and safe handovers",
      "summary": "Start with no Linux command knowledge. Navigate, inspect, copy, move, remove precisely and create private files, then complete a practical handover.",
      "prerequisites": [],
      "labs": [
        "lpic1-file-navigation",
        "lpic1-file-names",
        "lpic1-copy-move",
        "lpic1-file-cleanup",
        "lpic1-creation-mask",
        "lpic1-file-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "linux-access-policy",
      "track": "LPIC-1",
      "title": "Access policy and safe file changes",
      "summary": "Share with a known group, distinguish directory names from file content, update existing files and complete a permission-safe handover. Ordinary user; no root or real account changes.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "linux-file-foundations"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "lpic1-team-brief",
        "lpic1-drop-directory",
        "lpic1-update-existing",
        "lpic1-retire-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "linux-file-access",
      "track": "LPIC-1",
      "title": "File access and investigation",
      "summary": "Repair file access, investigate group and directory permissions, then locate and filter a simulated log.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "linux-access-policy"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "lpic1-permissions",
        "lpic1-traversal",
        "lpic1-logs"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "linux-file-search",
      "track": "LPIC-1",
      "title": "Search, investigate and hand over files",
      "summary": "Select the right files, repair a blocked search and hand over reports with the requested access.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "linux-file-access"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "lpic1-search-release-set",
        "lpic1-search-incomplete-intake",
        "lpic1-search-private-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "linux-service-recovery",
      "track": "LPIC-2",
      "title": "Service, DNS and storage recovery",
      "summary": "Diagnose saved versus active configuration, repair services and resolution, and investigate a capacity/mount problem. Assumes basic Linux file and command skills.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "linux-file-access"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "lpic2-service",
        "lpic2-dns",
        "lpic2-storage"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "shell-foundations",
      "track": "Bash/Shell",
      "title": "Reliable shell foundations",
      "summary": "Start with no shell knowledge. Build toward a safe report using quoted values, input, conditions, files and loops. Experienced learners can open any assignment directly.",
      "prerequisites": [],
      "labs": [
        "shell-handover",
        "shell-arguments",
        "shell-input",
        "shell-validation",
        "shell-report",
        "shell-loop",
        "shell-capstone"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "shell-composition",
      "track": "Bash/Shell",
      "title": "Streams, pipelines and resilient batches",
      "summary": "Repair output routing, compose filters, preserve final input records, and audit batches without hiding failures.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "shell-foundations"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "shell-streams",
        "shell-pipelines",
        "shell-eof",
        "shell-batch-audit"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "shell-reusable",
      "track": "Bash/Shell",
      "title": "Reusable functions and safe composition",
      "summary": "Build reusable helpers, handle per-item failures, consume arguments and validate before replacing a report.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "shell-composition"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "shell-functions",
        "shell-return",
        "shell-shift",
        "shell-bundle"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "shell-scope",
      "track": "Bash/Shell",
      "title": "Bash scope and safe helper design",
      "summary": "Debug shared-variable collisions, trace nested filter settings and repair a report builder that risks its inputs. Bash-specific local is taught explicitly; equivalent supported repairs are welcome.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "shell-reusable"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "shell-local-heading",
        "shell-scope-review",
        "shell-scope-capstone"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "shell-text",
      "track": "Bash/Shell",
      "title": "Text records and reliable audits",
      "summary": "Extract delimited fields, build stable manifests, count records correctly and publish a duplicate-identity audit. Portable shell with a documented GNU utility subset.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "shell-composition"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "shell-cut-inventory",
        "shell-sort-manifest",
        "shell-uniq-counts",
        "shell-text-capstone"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "shell-counts",
      "track": "Bash/Shell",
      "title": "Counters, totals and safe publication",
      "summary": "Number records, calculate whole-cent totals, plan full groups and leftovers, then publish a validated multi-file count report. Small supplied integer inputs; no floating-point or arbitrary-text numeric validation.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "shell-reusable"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "shell-number-records",
        "shell-order-total",
        "shell-pack-items",
        "shell-count-capstone"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "shell-file-batches",
      "track": "Bash/Shell",
      "title": "Filename selection and safe batch reports",
      "summary": "Discover changing file sets, collect incidents and publish a collision-safe handover from a captured source list.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "shell-counts"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "shell-file-manifest",
        "shell-collect-errors",
        "shell-file-batch-capstone"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "dns-forward",
      "track": "LPIC-2",
      "title": "Forward DNS: records, repairs and publication",
      "summary": "Add dual-stack hosts, trace alias failures, restore mail discovery, preserve address sets and complete a primary/secondary handover. In-memory forward records only; no full BIND, recursion, reverse zones or transfer protocol.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "linux-service-recovery"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "lpic2-dns-dualstack",
        "lpic2-dns-aliases",
        "lpic2-dns-mail",
        "lpic2-dns-rrsets",
        "lpic2-dns-secondary",
        "lpic2-dns-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "dns-reverse",
      "track": "LPIC-2",
      "title": "Reverse names and DNS handovers",
      "summary": "Repair IPv4 reverse names, publish an IPv6 rollout and retire addresses without stale answers.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "dns-forward"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "lpic2-dns-reverse-investigation",
        "lpic2-dns-reverse-ipv6",
        "lpic2-dns-reverse-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "shell-arrays",
      "track": "Bash/Shell",
      "title": "Bash lists, snapshots and safe handovers",
      "summary": "Preserve separate values, debug whole-list replacement, inspect grouped file selections, then preview or publish a validated handover. Bash-specific dense arrays; equivalent supported programs are accepted.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "shell-scope",
        "shell-file-batches"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "shell-array-intake",
        "shell-array-priority",
        "shell-array-package",
        "shell-array-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "linux-processes",
      "track": "LPIC-1",
      "title": "Process investigation and priority",
      "summary": "Select the right instance, distinguish pause from ending, understand pending signals and niceness, then complete a safe parent/child handover.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "linux-file-foundations",
        "linux-access-policy"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "lpic1-process-pause",
        "lpic1-process-pending",
        "lpic1-process-priority",
        "lpic1-process-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "lldp-discovery",
      "track": "CCNA",
      "title": "LLDP neighbors, inventory and handover",
      "summary": "Repair direction, refresh advertised inventory, retain inbound discovery while silencing one transmitter, and complete a multi-link handover. Explicit offline LLDP events; no CDP, IOS CLI or real network.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "vlan-data-foundations"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "ccna-lldp-receive",
        "ccna-lldp-inventory",
        "ccna-lldp-transmit-policy",
        "ccna-lldp-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "persistent-mounts",
      "track": "LPIC-2",
      "title": "Persistent mounts and stable volume identity",
      "summary": "Identify the intended filesystem, reconcile saved and live access, keep maintenance storage manual, then complete a multi-volume handover under changing device names. Clean in-memory metadata only; no real disks or system boot.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "linux-service-recovery"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "lpic2-mount-identity",
        "lpic2-mount-policy",
        "lpic2-mount-manual",
        "lpic2-mount-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "shell-command-capture",
      "track": "Bash/Shell",
      "title": "Command output, reliable decisions and report previews",
      "summary": "Prepare intact captured text, preserve useful command status, and combine isolated variables with safe shared-file effects.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "shell-text",
        "shell-scope"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "shell-capture-preview",
        "shell-capture-evidence",
        "shell-capture-decision",
        "shell-capture-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ipv4-access-policy",
      "track": "CCNA",
      "title": "IPv4 access policies without collateral blocking",
      "summary": "Build source filters, repair ordered service rules and direction, then hand over a two-router policy.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "ipv4-static-foundations"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "ccna-acl-source-policy",
        "ccna-acl-service-order",
        "ccna-acl-direction-repair",
        "ccna-acl-policy-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "local-account-lifecycle",
      "track": "LPIC-1",
      "title": "Local accounts and careful team handovers",
      "summary": "Create explicit identities and homes, repair groups, retain numeric evidence and complete a safe account handover.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "linux-access-policy"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "lpic1-account-onboarding",
        "lpic1-account-membership",
        "lpic1-account-retirement",
        "lpic1-account-team-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ospf-p2p-foundations",
      "track": "CCNA",
      "title": "Point-to-point OSPFv2 compatibility and route costs",
      "summary": "Diagnose identity and process faults, match configured P2P parameters, calculate directed equal-cost choices and hand over passive LAN advertisement.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "ipv4-static-foundations"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "ccna-ospf-router-identity",
        "ccna-ospf-p2p-parameters",
        "ccna-ospf-directed-ecmp",
        "ccna-ospf-passive-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "linux-unit-manager-foundations",
      "track": "LPIC-2",
      "title": "Service definitions, dependencies and target handover",
      "summary": "Compare saved and running settings, prepare required data, handle an optional failure and verify a careful service handover now and next session.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "linux-service-recovery"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "lpic2-unit-loaded-recovery",
        "lpic2-unit-preparation-order",
        "lpic2-unit-optional-wants",
        "lpic2-unit-target-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "shell-case-dispatch",
      "track": "Bash/Shell",
      "title": "Clear dispatch and safe publication",
      "summary": "Design exact operation interfaces, route ordered records and separate validation from publication.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "shell-command-capture",
        "shell-file-batches"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "shell-case-interface",
        "shell-case-routing",
        "shell-case-publication"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "shell-option-interfaces",
      "track": "Bash/Shell",
      "title": "Reliable short-option tools and independent jobs",
      "summary": "Build a flexible report interface, reuse independent parsers and publish only a completely validated multi-job plan.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "shell-case-dispatch",
        "shell-arrays",
        "shell-scope"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "shell-options-report",
        "shell-options-jobs",
        "shell-options-publication"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "dhcpv4-client-foundations",
      "track": "CCNA",
      "title": "DHCP client leases, relays and safe handover",
      "summary": "Separate applied policy from client-held leases, diagnose a relay and wrong mask, then hand over a reserved and shared address pool. Logical DHCP with supplied paths; no IOS commands, real packets or proof of router/DNS service.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "ipv4-foundations"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "ccna-dhcp-held-options",
        "ccna-dhcp-relay-scope",
        "ccna-dhcp-lease-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "debian-package-administration",
      "track": "LPIC-1",
      "title": "Debian packages: inspect, install, repair and retire",
      "summary": "Use supported package commands on separate sample workstations. Distinguish installed records, metadata, files and retention policies; preserve working software during repairs.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "linux-file-foundations"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "lpic1-package-install",
        "lpic1-package-metadata",
        "lpic1-package-payload",
        "lpic1-package-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "spanning-tree-steady-state",
      "track": "CCNA",
      "title": "Spanning-tree roots and stable paths",
      "summary": "Choose a root, diagnose local cost and parallel uplinks, then hand over a four-bridge topology. Ideal point-to-point steady state only; no protocol, PVST, guard or packet-delivery claim.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "vlan-data-foundations"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "ccna-stp-root",
        "ccna-stp-local-cost",
        "ccna-stp-parallel",
        "ccna-stp-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "shell-safe-automation",
      "track": "Bash/Shell",
      "title": "Reliable text input and careful publication",
      "summary": "Preserve complete records, detect a failed pipeline and publish a validated handover without changing protected files.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "shell-counts",
        "shell-composition",
        "shell-command-capture",
        "shell-text",
        "shell-case-dispatch",
        "shell-scope"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "shell-preserve-lines",
        "shell-pipeline-status",
        "shell-safe-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "static-web-services",
      "track": "LPIC-2",
      "title": "Static sites: names, pages, access and handover",
      "summary": "Route site names, choose and update pages, limit access to staff notes and verify a careful service handover.",
      "prerequisites": [],
      "labs": [
        "lpic2-web-routing",
        "lpic2-web-pages",
        "lpic2-web-access",
        "lpic2-web-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "basic-nat",
      "track": "CCNA",
      "title": "Basic NAT address mapping",
      "summary": "Repair a static address, diagnose dynamic eligibility and pool capacity after static reservations, then hand over real held mappings while preserving a neighboring static map.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "ipv4-foundations"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "ccna-nat-static",
        "ccna-nat-pool",
        "ccna-nat-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "rpm-package-investigation",
      "track": "LPIC-1",
      "title": "RPM records, providers, payloads and handover",
      "summary": "Choose a versioned provider, account for epoch ordering, repair actual recorded payload files and retire a provider while preserving its consumer and neighboring work.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "linux-file-foundations"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "lpic1-rpm-provider",
        "lpic1-rpm-epoch",
        "lpic1-rpm-payload",
        "lpic1-rpm-handover"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "shell-command-construction",
      "track": "Bash/Shell",
      "title": "Build and dispatch safe command requests",
      "summary": "Compose bounded argument lists, select known transformations and prepare results before publication.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "shell-arrays",
        "shell-text",
        "shell-case-dispatch",
        "shell-safe-automation"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "shell-command-options",
        "shell-command-dispatch",
        "shell-command-plan"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "nfs-network-file-sharing",
      "track": "LPIC-2",
      "title": "Shared files: export policy, clients and safe handover",
      "summary": "Restrict a reference share, diagnose publication permissions, move a client safely and complete a two-share handover while preserving neighboring work. Supplied virtual NFS only.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "persistent-mounts",
        "linux-file-access"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "lpic2-nfs-reference",
        "lpic2-nfs-publication",
        "lpic2-nfs-handover",
        "lpic2-nfs-capstone"
      ]
    }
  ]
}

new_unit.title: LACP: form, diagnose and safely migrate a bundle

append.insert_utf8:

    {
      "id": "ccna-lacp",
      "track": "CCNA",
      "title": "LACP: form, diagnose and safely migrate a bundle",
      "summary": "Supplied Layer 2 members, VLAN admission and independent cable-loss checks.",
      "prerequisites": [
        "vlan-data-foundations"
      ],
      "labs": [
        "ccna-lacp-initiation",
        "ccna-lacp-member-service",
        "ccna-lacp-resilient-handover"
      ]
    }
